purpose: Keep GPT-DOUG-LLM / XUNIA infrastructure observable, recoverable, capacity-aware, human-governed, and fail-closed during degraded conditions.

public_reference.title: Palantir / Gallatin AI public tactical logistics demo
public_reference.use: Architecture inspiration for common operating picture, forecast windows, configurable thresholds, course-of-action generation, human override, simulation, and approval-gated execution.

states.GREEN: healthy, verified, within configured operating thresholds
states.AMBER: degraded or forecast risk; recommend mitigation and require review for material actions
states.RED: critical shortfall or integrity failure; freeze nonessential mutation and prioritize recovery
states.BLACK: trust boundary compromised; quarantine affected route and require explicit recovery authorization

required_controls: continuous health telemetry for critical services
short-horizon forecast with confidence and timestamp
configurable thresholds rather than model-invented thresholds
human override at every material decision point
simulation or dry-run before consequential infrastructure mutation
checkpoint or snapshot before material mutation
least-privileged credentials and scoped service identities
append-only audit evidence for decisions and execution
fail-closed behavior when provenance, authorization, or integrity is unknown

decision_contract.observe: allowed read-only when scoped and authenticated
decision_contract.recommend: allowed; must include evidence, confidence, affected dependencies, and rollback plan
decision_contract.simulate: allowed in isolated or non-mutating mode
decision_contract.mutate: requires explicit policy allow; material or external changes require human approval
decision_contract.quarantine: allowed only for locally governed resources or explicitly authorized targets and must be auditable
decision_contract.restore: requires verified recovery point and post-restore validation

protected_planes: logs, audit evidence, and recovery checkpoints
invariants: model predictions are advisory, not authoritative state
humans retain authority for material or irreversible actions
no autonomous external dispatch from a forecast alone
unknown identity, provenance, scope, or integrity fails closed
a recovery action is not complete until post-change validation passes
public-reference architecture does not grant external platform access or affiliation
